findings.summary: No linked issue as the PR template requires; new public API contradicts quickstart advice to serialize first, needs maintainer design decision
Missing tests, CHANGES.rst entry, and docs updates required by the PR template
Hook only works at runtime; body's example fails mypy/pyright since ResponseReturnValue is unchanged
@staticmethod is inconsistent with other Flask override points; should be an instance method
Docstring doesn't say which return types never reach the hook

why: The reply objects to process (no issue, missing tests/docs) and typing, but never says the hook is unnecessary because users can already override make_response or return json.response directly.
